reviews.text: Had Manly Maids come out to fix a leaking pool. Crew determined where the leak was occurring which was opposite side of pool from the foundation shifts. Fixed the leak as part of the service call with no extra charges. Then went into the plumbing of my pool (old style) that had a valve located inside the pipe that was out preventing us from using our hot tub. He let me know the valve was obsolete now but was able to find the part for me to repair the valve myself. We now have a working hot tub! Five star service all around will be my first call for sure. Thanks guys!
reviews.author: Lance Lammons

reviews.text: DO NOT RECOMMEND!! HIGHLY UNPROFESSIONAL AND ALL YAPPERS NONE ELSE. DO NOT HAVE A SINGLE CLUE WHAT THEY DOING. Home Owners and property managers out there, requesting not to use this guy or his services!! you will get ripped off of your pocket!
reviews.author: Longhorn Preservation LLC

reviews.text: Alex did a great job and actually had to make two trips to complete the work needed.  He found our leak and sealed it.  His price is also much better than other companies around town.  Thanks, Manly Maids!
reviews.author: Gavin Secchi

reviews.text: My monthly water bill was reduced by $80 after having my pool leak detected and fixed by Eric at Manly Maids Leak Detection & Repair. Customer Service is second to none. Completely satisfied !
reviews.author: Raymond Ramirez

reviews.text: I'm so grateful for Manly Maids help in locating and repair the leak in my family pool. I really appreciate the communication we had with them. They explained the process to locating the leak and then the repair as well. They provided an estimate and stuck to it . They told us of the time and dates they would be able to  work on the pool,and they showed up and always did what they had said they do. They were very easy to work with and totally professional  on time with no problems. I would highly recommend Manly Maids for a hassle free detection and repair. Thank you !!!
reviews.author: Londy Sapp

reviews.text: Have unfortunately needed their services twice in two years. But we are so grateful we found them. Awesome people to work with. Very reasonable cost. Very friendly and professional.  Just all around great company. I RARELY have the opportunity to say that about any. Know y from whom we’ve needed repairs, etc. especially when it comes to the dang pool!
reviews.author: Nancy Cairns

reviews.text:
***VINYL POOL LINER OWNERS CALL THIS COMPANY FOR LEAK DETECTION.

They did an incredibly thorough inspection of liner while diving with dye. Great price on repairs!

After 2 horrible experiences with bigger and better reviewed companies in FTW where my leak was misdiagnosed and or completely missed Manly Maids came out and quickly and efficiently found issue. They made sure pool was fixed and patched all the tiny holes/rips in vinyl.  Nobody likes to do vinyl so having a company with someone who has lots of experience with vinyl is a blessing.
reviews.author: N B

reviews.text: Nathan, Alex and Eric do excellent work. Not only are they extremely prompt and dependable, they are a delight to have around. They fixed my leaking pool and broken pump quickly, and for a very good value. I highly recommend Many Maids.
reviews.author: Katherine Wynne
